raw_text: Indian Army Chief's Provocative Remarks Against Pakistan Surface Online. A video showing the Indian Chief of Army Staff making threatening statements about preemptive strikes against Pakistan has gone viral on social media. The footage appears to show the Army Chief in a military briefing setting making aggressive statements about Pakistan's defence capabilities. Pakistan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs has demanded an explanation from India regarding the alarming statements.
clean_text: ARY News reported on viral video of Indian Army Chief making threatening statements. Pakistan's foreign ministry demanded explanation. Video later debunked as deepfake with face-swap technology.
